name: NMDC Group
verdict: Alpha Dhabi Holding holds about 77% of NMDC Group; International Holding Company is Alpha Dhabi Holding's parent; IHC is controlled by Royal Group, Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed Al Nahyan's holding.
note: Abu Dhabi dredging/energy EPC group; on the chest and sleeves of the 2026 UAE Team L'IMAD kit. Rating note: proposed none by the contributor of 2026-10-03, on hold for a maintainer. The chain is NMDC Group -> Alpha Dhabi Holding (~77%, AD Ports Group press release 2025-11-27) -> IHC (parent company per Alpha Dhabi's 2025 financial report) -> Royal Group, treated as Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed's private holding (the G42 review of 2026-09-27 treated Royal Group as private, not the state). No state stake and no human-rights finding against NMDC, Alpha Dhabi or IHC sourced.
